function.name: SET_TITLE
function.abstract: It establishes the title of the game window

description.p: This function allows to choose the title of the game window, if the game does not work to full screen. It is necessary to call to this function to use , because that is the function which will create and show the game window. You must remember that SET_MODE initializes normally the game to full screen: to initialize the window mode, you must change the value of the variable before calling to .
It is not possible to change the title of a window which is running, but you can call to again to active the changes.
